summary: I checked the Cowboys-Buccaneers Thursday night injury report, the Nobel Peace Prize field, Bitcoin's current price against several threshold markets, tonight's NHL games (Predators-Maple Leafs, Blues-Blackhawks, Islanders-Rangers, Senators-Red Wings), the USA-Canada and Mexico-Chile soccer friendlies, Elon Musk's tweet count, and fresh Brazil runoff polling. Search results for Bitcoin's price were contradictory and some NHL and NFL injury reports returned old or mismatched-year data, so I could not trust any of them enough to size a bet. Nobel odds trackers put Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms as the clear favorite at 24 to 28 percent, well above our only candidate there, Mykola Kuleba, which lines up with his 9 cent ask rather than exposing a mispricing. My only open position, Lula to win the Brazil runoff, is unchanged: pre-runoff polls still show the race close to even (Lula 44-47 percent vs Flavio 42-44), matching the thesis behind that trade, so I am holding it. No market cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees, so I made zero trades this cycle.
